name: make_sense_fullstack
author: Davy ROBERT
description: Makesense is an international community founded in 2010 that supports and brings together citizens, entrepreneurs and organizations to solve today's social and environmental challenges together. The aim is to develop a platform that will be internal to the association, and that will serve as a decision-making management tool, with a history and follow-up managed dynamically between users according to different statuses.

scripts.setup: npm install && husky init && npm --prefix ./frontend install && npm --prefix ./backend install
scripts.setupProd: npm i --omit=dev && husky init && npm --prefix ./frontend i --omit=dev && npm --prefix ./backend i --omit=dev
scripts.buildfix: npm run fix && cd frontend/ && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n front,back -c green,yellow -t "HH:mm:ss" -p "{name} {time}" "npm --prefix ./frontend run dev" "npm --prefix ./backend run dev"
scripts.start: NODE_ENV=production npm run build && concurrently -n front,back -c green,yellow -t "HH:mm:ss" -p "{name} {time}" "npm --prefix ./frontend run start-front" "npm --prefix ./backend run start"
scripts.devHost: concurrently -n front,back -c green,yellow -t "HH:mm:ss" -p "{name} {time}" "npm --prefix ./frontend run devHost" "npm --prefix ./backend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix ./frontend run test && npm --prefix ./backend run test
scripts.fix: npm --prefix ./frontend run fix && npm --prefix ./backend run fix
scripts.delete: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && cd frontend && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && cd ../backend && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json
scripts.update: concurrently -n current,backend,frontend -c green,yellow,blue "ncu -u" "cd backend && ncu -u" "cd frontend && ncu -u"
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm --prefix ./frontend run preview
scripts.previewHost: npm run build && npm --prefix ./frontend run previewHost
